text: ララ…　ぼーくが　ポケモン　くりだせばー　あのコも　このコも　くぎづけさー

structure.jp: ぼーくが　ポケモン　くりだせばー
structure.en: when I send out my Pokémon

structure.jp: あのコも　このコも
structure.en: that girl and this girl too

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb ending to ば means 'if' or 'when' that happens; the long ー is only him singing. ポケモン　くりだせば = 'when I send out my Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜も〜も
patterns.span: あのコも　このコも
patterns.explanation: も said twice means 'both this and that'. あのコも　このコも = 'both that girl and this girl'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: さ at the end states something in a breezy, sure-of-himself way, standing in for だ. くぎづけさ = 'they're riveted, you know'.
